title: AION 2 Presets: Download and Apply Styles
description: Find AION 2 character presets in the official Global Style Shop, follow player-reported download and upload steps, and resolve missing appearances.
summary: Use Global Style Shop for shared appearances or recreate a creator's published sliders manually. Match the website account and character, preview first, and check the game's current application cost.
quickAnswer: Browse the official Style Shop, select your recipient character and download a shared appearance. The Global player-reported application route is Customizations → Manage Appearance → Refresh; preview it and check the displayed Quna or voucher cost before applying.

topic.alt: Official English Style Shop with region, period and popularity-sort controls above player appearance previews
topic.caption: Official Global Style Shop, October 3, 2026: signed-out view with North America - West, Past 7 Days and Most Downloaded selected. Previews are player creations. This screenshot verifies browsing controls, not a completed download or paid application.

workflow.title: Send a style to the intended existing character
workflow.caption: The download and in-game application are separate steps. This sequence follows the cited Global player's report; always inspect the current confirmation.

steps.label: Match identity and recipient
steps.description: Sign in with your playing platform and select the intended character in Change Character.

steps.label: Choose a Global listing
steps.description: Set your region, inspect the author's preview and open the desired appearance.

steps.label: Download to an offered slot
steps.description: Use the slots presented to your account; do not infer a permanent count from a guide.

steps.label: Refresh on the same character
steps.description: Open Customizations → Manage Appearance in game and refresh before choosing the preview.

steps.label: Review before applying
steps.description: Check the actual appearance and current Quna or voucher terms before confirmation.
